name: Felix, Gaijin
source:
"Felix, Gaijin" tells the story of a German exchange student named Felix. Although he learned a lot about Japanese culture and language, he needs some help in dealing with the Japanese way of life.
While in Japan Felix fell in love with a female co-student who has already fallen in love by herself...
translation:
《Felix, Gaijin》讲述德国交换生菲利克斯的故事。尽管他已经学到许多日本文化和语言知识，面对日本式生活方式时仍需要一些帮助。
在日本期间，菲利克斯爱上了一名女同学，而她已经有了心上人……
